explanation: Punctuality is taken seriously in UK business culture and is seen as a sign of professionalism and respect for other people's time. Turning up late to a meeting without warning comes across as rude and can suggest poor planning; a few minutes' delay is usually forgiven if you apologise and give advance notice, but persistent lateness damages your professional reputation.
local_tip: Aim to arrive on time or a few minutes early for a business meeting, and message or call ahead the moment you know you'll be late.

also_check.note: Punctuality is taken even more seriously than in the UK; arriving even a minute late is considered disrespectful.
Arriving 15-30 minutes late to a business meeting is often tolerated and can be normal, though this varies by company and region.
Meetings may start later than scheduled due to a more flexible cultural approach to time, though punctuality from visitors is still appreciated.
